## Setup

**Add these Lead Pool columns:** `email_check_result`  `email_is_role`  `sendability`  `email_verified_at`  `domain_age_years`

Credential is the existing **Email-Check.app API** header auth (header name must be `x-api-key`).

Run Manual Test Trigger first, check the sendability spread, then activate.

---

### Why pre-filter, not verify

Most of this pool is on Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, which refuse to confirm mailbox existence. Tested: `steven.rivera@abc-usa.org` (MX = mail.protection.outlook.com) returns `validSmtp: null`. No service can do better.

So this removes what is provably bad and grades the rest:
- `sendable` — SMTP confirmed (rare)
- `sendable_unverified` — MX good, mailbox unconfirmable. **The bulk of your pool. This is normal.**
- `role_account` / `risky_new_domain` / `likely_invalid` / `do_not_send`

Deliverability proof comes from the bounce handler.
